paper_title: CardioNeural-SoC: An Indigenous RISC-V-Based Mixed-Signal System-on-Chip for Multi-Modal Cardiac and Neurological Monitoring — Architecture, RTL Verification, and Pre-Silicon Synthesis Results

questions.question: What is the main objective of the CardioNeural-SoC project, and what problem is it designed to address?
What are the main architectural components of CardioNeural-SoC, and how does the RISC-V processor interact with the mixed-signal components?
Which cardiac and neurological signals or physiological modalities does CardioNeural-SoC support, and how are they acquired or monitored?
What RTL verification methods and test scenarios are used to evaluate the functional correctness of CardioNeural-SoC?
What pre-silicon synthesis results are reported, including the available area, timing, power, or resource utilization metrics?
